limitations: The August 2026 UPU publication confirms that Nicaragua requires a numeric five-digit postcode, but it is not a current complete operator assignment denominator or postal geometry licence.
The 05/2014 UPU sheet documents address placement, digit semantics and examples; it is not current assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception or explicit non-area data.

The current Correos lookup and detail URLs returned Cloudflare managed challenges in both HTTP and headless-browser retrieval, so search-engine snippets were not treated as fixed current operator content.
The reviewed INETER pages expose administrative and base spatial services, not a postcode geometry release or competent-authority crosswalk; administrative layers were not promoted.
The real NI API returned unavailable and the running app showed no translucent postal area, boundary or postal provenance.
